dedupe_keys.name: synthetic dataset of heating energy flexibility in uk office buildings

description: This synthetic dataset contains 2,000 EnergyPlus models of UK office buildings and their simulated heating electricity meter data under a baseline and several demand-response strategies, built to study the energy flexibility of heat-pump-heated offices. It was created at University College London by Kexin Xie, Rui Tang and Dimitrios Rovas and published in the UCL Research Data Repository on 26 January 2026. Each building has an identifier from 0 to 1999 and a metadata sheet of 11 variables; meter series are given for the baseline and four demand-response cases, with a London weather file. Access: CSV meter files of about 70 MB each and zipped model batches, with the generation code on GitHub. Licence: CC0; free. Caveats: buildings are synthetic, so they represent plausible UK offices, not real ones, and one weather file is used. Simulation uses: training and testing flexibility estimators, demand-response control and grid-interaction studies for building portfolios. Related records: EnergyPlus, which produced the series, and the End-Use Load Profiles for the U.S. building stock.
